title: Which of six localities gets an integrated care board's hypnotic deprescribing pharmacist team for 2027, and how many emergency admissions for a fall it avoids there, with each locality's fall admissions, bed-days and 30-day readmissions in 2025-26
subdomain: benefit-risk-assessment (the falls a deprescribing team avoids, from each current user's excess risk by time since first starting a benzodiazepine or Z-drug)
prompt_shape: 07: one of six localities with its sized avoidance, runner-up and gap, and a grid of four falls measures for each of six localities (24 figures)
stated_inputs: the deprescribing policy's current-user definition, stop share, off-drug window, base rate and rate ratios (hypnotics_deprescribing_policy_2026.pdf)
the falls dashboard's F1 to F3 definitions (falls_indicator_definition_v2.pdf)

sources.origin: generated by task118/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional integrated care board with six localities: the patients aged 60 or over dispensed a benzodiazepine or Z-drug from April to September 2026, their GP repeat templates and one locality's previous-system export, the practice register, the board's policy and falls definitions, and a SUS falls cohort with its hospital sites; layouts follow the public files named, every organisation, place and person is invented, and no real dataset is reproduced.
